results.xfail_reason: FOUND 2026-08-02: Excel Export costs ~1.3 SECONDS PER ROW, linear. Measured across four independent runs the same day: 1 row 3.1s, 2 rows 5.3s, 10 rows 15.7-17.2s, and a live sample of a running export sustained 0.67 rows/sec. So 1,000 rows takes ~22 minutes and 10,000 rows ~3.6 hours - a realistic export is effectively unusable. Tiers 1-2 never saw this because they only ever export 2 or 10 rows. OWNER DECISION PENDING.
